remarks: Welcome to 85 Camp Ave in Stamford, CT, a bright and well-maintained tri-level townhouse located in the highly desirable Springdale neighborhood. This commuter-friendly home offers modern comfort, excellent amenities, and convenient access to everything Stamford has to offer.  One of the few units in the complex featuring hardwood floors throughout, this newer home offers a clean, modern aesthetic and easy maintenance. The open-concept living area is filled with natural light and flows seamlessly into the updated kitchen, complete with modern appliances, ample cabinetry, and functional workspace.  The home features a spacious bedroom with a large closet, providing generous storage and comfortable living. The tastefully designed bathroom offers a calm and relaxing retreat.  Residents enjoy beautifully maintained grounds and access to resort-style amenities including a swimming pool, fitness center, and clubhouse.  Located in the sought-after Springdale section of Stamford, this home offers easy access to:  * Metro-North train station for easy NYC commuting * Restaurants, cafes, and shopping * Parks and recreation * Major highways for convenient travel  Ideal for professionals, commuters, or anyone seeking a low-maintenance home in a prime Stamford location.
